description: Complete vehicle purchase simulator. Calculates monthly installment (CDC financing or consortium), annual IPVA tax by Brazilian state (2026 rates), estimated insurance range (3%-7%), projected 5-year depreciation, and total cost of ownership over 5 years. Also provides side-by-side comparison of CDC vs consortium installments. Use to plan a complete vehicle purchase budget before deciding on financing modality.

anoFabricacaoVeiculo.description: Vehicle manufacturing year. Affects depreciation estimates.

custosTransacao.description: One-shot acquisition transaction costs grouped by category. Each item: { categoria, valorCents, descricao? }. Categories: dpvat, licenciamento, emplacamento, taxa_cadastro_financiamento, seguro_prestamista, transferencia_propriedade, outro. Adds to the total acquisition value and 5-year cost of ownership.

estadoUf.description: Brazilian state where the vehicle will be registered. Determines the IPVA (vehicle tax) rate.

modalidade.description: "cdc" = Direct Consumer Credit (bank financing with interest), "consorcio" = consortium (no interest, administration fee only)

prazoMeses.description: Financing term in months. Ex: 48 = 4 years

taxaAdminConsorcio.description: Total consortium administration fee over the term (%). Ex: 20 = 20%

taxaJurosAnualBps.description: Annual interest rate in basis points. Ex: 1850 = 18.5% per year (typical CDC in 2026)

valorVeiculoCents.description: Vehicle value in cents. Ex: R$ 80,000 = 8000000

name: calcular_planejamento_compra_veiculo
